# larkfield-api: staging environment (AWS eu-west-2)
# Copy to .env and fill in the credentials. Never commit the real .env.

# Port the Express server listens on (defaults to 3000 if unset)

# Replace USER and PASSWORD with your staging DB credentials.
DATABASE_URL=postgres://USER:PASSWORD@pg-stg-3.larkfield.internal:5432/larkfield_stg
